summary: For operator-based AAP, add the proxy to the AutomationController spec as extra_settings with setting AWX_TASK_ENV and HTTP_PROXY, HTTPS_PROXY, NO_PROXY (and lowercase variants) values.
questions: How do I configure an egress proxy for operator-based AAP?
Set HTTPS_PROXY for controller jobs on OpenShift

answer_card.title: Egress proxy on OpenShift (operator)
answer_card.answer_md:
In the `AutomationController` YAML:
```yaml
spec:
  extra_settings:
    - setting: AWX_TASK_ENV
      value:
        HTTPS_PROXY: 'https://192.168.0.XXX:3128'
        HTTP_PROXY: 'https://192.168.0.XXX:3128'
        NO_PROXY: 10.0.0.0/8
        https_proxy: 'https://192.168.0.XXX:3128'
        http_proxy: 'https://192.168.0.XXX:3128'
        no_proxy: 10.0.0.0/8
```
